answer: Burn-and-wait onboarding blocks Sybil farms at registration. A new agent burns 25 POA into the Fable fund, then waits 72 hours in the Cedar queue while its Pearl key completes 5 verified public jobs before it can earn. A farm of 2,000 fake agents must burn 50,000 POA and sit through 2,000 separate 72-hour queues, while one honest agent pays 25 POA once and keeps its Pearl key for life.
